mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courtship_witnesses(id, user_id, title, content, photo_url, status) VALUES(#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{photoUrl}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.user_id, COALESCE(p.nickname, u.username) AS nickname, w.title, w.content, w.photo_url, w.status, w.created_at FROM courtship_witnesses w JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id LEFT JOIN courtship_profiles p ON p.user_id = w.user_id WHERE w.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courtship_witnesses WHERE status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT w.id, w.user_id, COALESCE(p.nickname, u.username) AS nickname, w.title, w.content, w.photo_url, w.status, w.created_at FROM courtship_witnesses w JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id LEFT JOIN courtship_profiles p ON p.user_id = w.user_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
